title: scene-policy
description: The scene-policy logging workspace (LEO-241): every reconcile decision and outcome, written by bin/,scene-apply.sh (the enforced seam) and read by the shell, `,hyprfocus explain` and the modes' Veto surface. Three files and one log: log.jsonl appends one decision row per line; applied.json holds the last applied state so the next transition knows what to hand back; last.json is the once-per-apply reader surface (vetoes and outcomes), watched live like theme.result.json. Everything here is an observation — a timestamped diary of a day's transitions; state directory only, never committed in plaintext, bounded retention (the log keeps its last 2000 rows, LEO-241's stated bound).

logRow.description: One decision the seam appended to log.jsonl. `action` is the verb (stop/start/skip/units gate), `outcome` what actually happened, `unit` or a gate summary names what it decided about.

mood.description: The active mode at decision time.

unit.description: The unit (or 'gate' when the row is a gate summary).

outcome.description: What actually happened: stopped, started, would-stop, vetoed, skip-protected, failed, or not-installed.

applied.description: applied.json — the last transition's outcome. Only units ACTUALLY stopped are recorded: a vetoed unit keeps running (LEO-256), and a later mood must not 'hand back' a start it never lost.

last.description: last.json — what the last apply held back and honoured; watched by the shell (SceneVeto) once per apply.
